title: River Development Agent Operational Executor Integration Entry Foundation
objective: Establish the first operational integration entry between the governed operation-execution authorization chain and the existing production implementation executor without allowing requested apply mode to constitute its own authorization.
requiredBehavior: Preserve existing package validation as defense in depth.
Preserve dry-run as the default non-mutating implementation mode.
Distinguish an apply request from governed authorization to perform apply.
Require the existing governed operation-execution authorization contract before admitting an apply request into the production implementation executor.
Reject missing, unauthorized, malformed, or mismatched governed authorization by default.
Do not reinterpret the DEV-313 closure artifact as execution authority.
Do not create broad repository mutation authority.
Do not execute an operation during DEV-314 implementation or validation.
productionIntegrationRule: Production caller modification is permitted only after the DEV-314 entry contract is implemented, tested, and its exact integration seam is proven.
completionCriteria: A typed operational execution-entry contract exists.
Apply intent and governed apply authorization are distinct.
Existing governed authorization is consumed rather than recreated.
No broad repository authority is introduced.
The next production integration step is explicit and testable.
